products.title: Lockdown 101: Quickstart Guide To Success by Cameron Mellott
products.body:
Master the art of controlling your opponent from the bottom with "Lockdown 101 Quickstart Guide to Success" by Cameron Mellott, a rising start under the world famous Tom DeBlass

  • The lockdown is a very secure and effective position that is amazing for slowing down the game and taking control of your opponent 
  • A very overlooked position, the lockdown can be a great equalizer
  • Training under Tom DeBlass, Cameron has developed a modern and effective approach on half guard and focused on the lockdown  
  • See why he has so much competition success using this position 
  • Stop overlooking the lockdown and start USING it 


Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

Master the art of controlling your opponent from the bottom with "Lockdown 101 Quickstart Guide to Success" by Cameron Mellott, a rising start under the world famous Tom DeBlass. This comprehensive Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu instructional is designed to teach beginners and seasoned practitioners alike the fundamental techniques of the Lockdown position. Whether you're looking to improve your sweeps, submissions, or overall control, this guide offers clear, step-by-step instructions to enhance your grappling skills.

Cameron Mellott, a seasoned BJJ practitioner with years of experience, breaks down each technique in an easy-to-understand format, ensuring that even beginners can grasp and apply these principles effectively. Discover how to dominate your opponents from the bottom position and turn defense into offense with the powerful concepts taught in this guide.

Unlock the secrets of the Lockdown position and take your BJJ game to the next level with "Lockdown 101 Quickstart Guide to Success."

Bullet Points:

  • Learn essential techniques of the Lockdown position in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu.
  • Perfect for beginners and experienced practitioners looking to enhance their ground game.
  • Step-by-step instructions and detailed demonstrations by Cameron Mellott.
  • Master sweeps, submissions, and control from the bottom position.
  • Transform your defensive strategies into offensive opportunities.
  • Clear and concise explanations suitable for all skill levels.
  • Developed by Cameron Mellott, a trusted name in the BJJ community.
  • Ideal for those looking to deepen their understanding of ground control and positioning.
  • Includes drills and practice tips to reinforce learning.
  • Elevate your grappling skills with proven techniques and strategies.

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1

  • Intro
  • 10-Minute Toolkit: Lockdown
  • Outside Lockdown, Knee Lever, & Back Take
  • Outside Lockdown, Back Takes Expanded, & Arm Drags


Part 2

  • Entering the Inside Lockdown/Outside to Inside Lockdown
  • Intermediate Details for Inside Lockdown & Countering the Crossface
  • Attacking the Reap from Inside Lockdown
  • Leg Attacks from the Lockdown
  • Leg Attacks from the Lockdown II
  • Leg Attacks from the Lockdown III


Part 3

  • Responding to the Hip Switch from Inside the Lockdown
  • Countering Shoulder Pressure from Inside & Outside Lockdown
  • Countering the Underhook Using the Lockdown
  • Countering and Defending the Lockdown from the Top Introductory


Part 4

  • Passing from the Lockdown Expanded
  • Inside Lockdown Counters/Defense Intermediate
  • Calf Slicers from Lockdown
  • Attacking The Outside Lockdown from Top Half Guard
  • Outro
